description:
Comprehensive Hardware Analysis, Monitoring and Reporting for Windows and DOS.


- Fixed NGU clock reporting on Arrow Lake.
- Added reporting of GPU Hot Spot Temperature for NVIDIA Blackwell.
- Added per-chip VRAM temperature monitoring for NVIDIA GPUs with GDDR6X/GDDR7.
- Enhanced sensor monitoring on GIGABYTE next-gen Intel motherboards.
- Added AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT LP and Radeon RX 9050.
- Added per-chip VRAM temperature monitoring for AMD Navi GPUs.
- Improved support of Hygon C86.
- Added ability to move OSD window without title.
- Added preliminary support of Razor Lake AX.
- Enhanced sensor monitoring on ASUS ROG CROSSHAIR 2006.
- Added monitoring of System domain clock on NVIDIA GPUs.
